institutionalSections.title: The interface is only the visible part.
institutionalSections.intro: Aloha AI works with founders, institutions, legal and compliance teams, educators, researchers, regulated operators, and expert-led organizations. The deliverable may be a website, dashboard, agent, assessment, portal, curriculum, report, or monitor. The work underneath is deciding what the system should know, which sources it should trust, how decisions should be made, where humans remain responsible, and how the system stays current.

seoTitle: Aloha AI | Complex work, made usable
editorialIntro: A neuroscience-informed AI practice for regulated and reputation-sensitive work, built around how humans actually trust and use it. Every figure traces to a primary source, a human stays accountable for every consequential output, and the system is designed so your people adopt it. Most consultants install a tool and leave. I build the human system around it, because a confident wrong answer is expensive.
Aloha AI builds governed AI teams for regulated work — and teaches you to build your own. The background that makes that credible is right below.

editorialSections.title: Serious organizations hit the same two walls with AI

blocks.text: They can't trust the facts

Generic AI hallucinates worst on the exact things that matter: the citation, the quota, the statutory trigger. I call it the Operator Execution Gap, the distance between what AI says and what you can act on. Closing it is the whole job.
Their people won't use it

A rollout stalls not because the tool is bad, but because no one built the trust and habit around it. Adoption is a neuroscience problem, not a software one, and that is exactly where my background sits.
